const [mode, base, step, evidenceRoot, closureFile, closureSha256, preparedSha256] = process.argv.slice(2);

const sha = b => crypto.createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');
const ref = file => ({ file, sha256: sha(fs.readFileSync(file)) });
const save = (file, value) => { fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n', { flag: 'wx' }); return ref(file); };
const read = file => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(file));
const uuid = () => crypto.randomUUID();
const offline = { PATH: '/usr/bin:/bin', LANG: 'C', LC_ALL: 'C', GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: '/dev/null', GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: '1', GIT_NO_LAZY_FETCH: '1', GIT_NO_REPLACE_OBJECTS: '1', GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS: '0', GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: '0', DISABLE_TELEMETRY: '1', DO_NOT_TRACK: '1' };
let commandIndex = 0;
function command(argv, cwd, env = offline) {
  const startedAtMs = Date.now(), p = spawnSync(argv[0], argv.slice(1), { cwd, env, timeout: 60000, maxBuffer: 16 * 1024 * 1024 }), endedAtMs = Date.now();
  const prefix = path.join(base, `${mode}-${step ?? 'setup'}-command-${String(++commandIndex).padStart(4, '0')}`);
  fs.writeFileSync(prefix + '.stdout', p.stdout ?? Buffer.alloc(0), { flag: 'wx' });
  fs.writeFileSync(prefix + '.stderr', p.stderr ?? Buffer.alloc(0), { flag: 'wx' });
  const receipt = save(prefix + '.json', { argv, cwd, env, startedAtMs, endedAtMs, exitCode: p.status, signal: p.signal, error: p.error?.code ?? null, tool: ref(fs.realpathSync(argv[0])), stdout: ref(prefix + '.stdout'), stderr: ref(prefix + '.stderr') });
  assert.equal(p.status, 0, `${argv[0]} ${argv.slice(1).join(' ')}: ${p.stderr}`);
  assert.equal(p.signal, null); assert.equal(p.error, undefined);
  return { stdout: (p.stdout ?? Buffer.alloc(0)).toString(), receipt };
}
const git = (root, ...args) => command(['/usr/bin/git', '-C', root, '-c', 'user.name=fixture', '-c', 'user.email=fixture@example.invalid', '-c', 'commit.gpgsign=false', '-c', 'core.hooksPath=/dev/null', ...args], root).stdout.trim();
function gitIdentity(root) {
  const resolve = value => fs.realpathSync(path.resolve(root, value));
  return { root, gitDir: resolve(git(root, 'rev-parse', '--git-dir')), gitCommonDir: resolve(git(root, 'rev-parse', '--git-common-dir')), branchRef: git(root, 'symbolic-ref', 'HEAD'), commit: git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'), tree: git(root, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'), dirty: git(root, 'status', '--porcelain=v1', '--untracked-files=all') !== '' };
}
const j = (name, value) => save(path.join(base, name + '-' + uuid() + '.json'), value);
const out = name => path.join(base, name + '-' + uuid());
const C1 = 'c1dca808811357a10839287cf12a5316a130c95d';
const TREE = 'f3b44d57710592be2e3458182efa0057e37e17df';

const runtime = () => auto.readRuntimeState({ projectRoot: c.root });
const canonical = () => { const view = auto.readState({ projectRoot: c.root, requireAgreement: true }); return { view, envelope: view.agreement.agreement }; };
function currentInputs() {
  const steps = path.join(base, 'steps'); let baseline = null;
  if (fs.existsSync(steps)) for (const name of fs.readdirSync(steps).sort()) { const file = path.join(steps, name, 'after.json'); if (fs.existsSync(file)) baseline = read(file).baseline; }
  return { extraction: c.extraction.identity, graph: c.extraction.graph, plan: c.extraction.plan, baseline, acceptedStore: { root: path.join(base, 'store'), expectedHeadSha256: checker.readAcceptedStore(path.join(base, 'store')).headSha256 } };
}
function associations() {
  const folder = path.join(base, 'actors'); if (!fs.existsSync(folder)) return [];
  return fs.readdirSync(folder).sort().flatMap(name => { const dir = path.join(folder, name); if (!fs.statSync(dir).isDirectory()) return []; const files = fs.readdirSync(dir).filter(f => /^\d{3}-association\.json$/.test(f)).sort(); if (!files.length) return []; const latest = ref(path.join(dir, files.at(-1))), a = t.transitionBound(latest); return runtime().reservations.get(a.reservationId)?.state === 'closed' ? [] : [latest]; });
}
function request(extra = {}) {
  const attemptId = uuid(), phase = extra.phase ?? 'resume', resumeId = phase === 'start' ? null : uuid(), source = gitIdentity(c.integration);
  return { schema: 'fvs/auto-resume-request', schemaVersion: 1, attemptId, runId: c.runId, phase, resumeId,
    ao: { tool: ref(c.aoTool), stateHome: c.aoHome, projectId: c.projectId, coordinatorSessionId: 'coordinator' }, expectedHeadSha256: runtime().headSha256,
    source: { kind: 'git', root: c.integration, commit: source.commit, expectedTree: source.tree }, inputs: currentInputs(), associations: associations(), priorAccounting: c.accounting,
    memoryRequest: auto.prepareMemoryRequest({ projectRoot: c.root, attemptId, operation: 'coordinator-refresh', phase, target: { projectId: c.projectId, sessionId: 'coordinator', resumeId } }), transition: null, ...extra };
}
function invoke(q, label, operation = 'checkpoint') {
  const output = out(label), result = auto[operation === 'state' ? 'reconcileState' : 'checkpointState']({ projectRoot: c.root, request: q, out: output });
  const manifest = j(label, { q, out: output, result }); console.log(label, result.code, result.observation?.transition?.admissibility?.status, manifest.file);
  return { q, out: output, result, manifest };
}
function association(intent, before, worktree, sessionId = 'owned-proof-fixture') {
  const g = gitIdentity(worktree); assert.equal(g.dirty, false); const { root, dirty, ...rest } = g;
  return { schema: 'fvs/auto-session-association', schemaVersion: 1, runId: c.runId, assignmentId: intent.effect.assignmentId, reservationId: intent.reservationId, projectId: c.projectId, sessionId,
    scopeRelation: 'run-assignment', nodes: intent.nodes, owner: intent.owner, controllerSessionId: 'coordinator', worktree: { path: root, ...rest },
    provenance: { kind: 'controller-launch', beforeEventSha256: before, evidence: [j('fixture-association-provenance', { authority: 'owned controller association; AO protocol double, not provider or OS attestation', worktree, before })] }, rulesProfile: null };
}
const before = intent => ({ position: 'before', intent, beforeEventSha256: null, outcome: null, effect: null });
const after = (b, completion) => ({ position: 'after', intent: b.q.transition.intent, beforeEventSha256: b.result.recordedEventSha256, outcome: 'succeeded', effect: { sessionId: null, association: null, evidence: [completion], resolution: null } });
function basis(name) { const v = read(path.join(base, name + '-after.json')); return { beforeEventSha256: v.beforeEventSha256, afterEventSha256: v.afterEventSha256, completion: v.completion }; }
function makeAction(kind, stage, nodes, target, previous = null, prepared = null) {
  const q = prepared?.q ?? request(), intent = { transitionId: uuid(), reservationId: uuid(), stage, nodes, owner: 'qualification-controller', effect: { kind: 'local', operation: stage } };
  const run = runtime().state.run;
  // Proposal data only; the production checkpoint independently re-observes all
  // identities and validates the exact equality before committing permission.
  const observation = { identity: { source: gitIdentity(c.integration) }, associations: associations().map(reference => ({ reference, value: t.transitionBound(reference) })) };
  const snapshot = prepared?.snapshot ?? t.transitionSnapshot({ q, run, canonical: canonical(), observation, action: { before: { registry: { root: c.registry } }, target, owner: intent.owner, nodes, authorization: c.authorization, profile: c.profile } }, { profileObservation: c.profileObservation, observeWorktree: w => ({ ...w, dirty: gitIdentity(w.path).dirty }) });
  const action = { schema: 'fvs/auto-transition-request', schemaVersion: 1, runId: c.runId, transitionId: intent.transitionId, reservationId: intent.reservationId, kind, stage, nodes, owner: intent.owner,
    expectedHeadSha256: q.expectedHeadSha256, before: snapshot, target, authorization: c.authorization, profile: c.profile, basis: previous };
  const actionRef = j('action-' + step, action); intent.request = actionRef; q.transition = before(intent); return { q, action, actionRef };
}
function completion(item, b, commandRef, resultRef) {
  return j('completion-' + step, { schema: 'fvs/auto-transition-completion', schemaVersion: 1, runId: c.runId, transitionId: item.action.transitionId, reservationId: item.action.reservationId,
    actionSha256: memory.memoryHash(item.action), beforeEventSha256: b.result.recordedEventSha256, command: commandRef, result: resultRef });
}
function verifyOriginalFiles() {
  const inventory = read(path.join(base, 'fixture-input-inventory.json'));
  for (const row of inventory) assert.equal(sha(fs.readFileSync(path.join(c.integration, row.path))), row.sha256, row.path);
  assert.equal(git(c.integration, 'rev-parse', 'HEAD^{tree}'), TREE);
  return inventory;
}

const basisOf = name => { const a = done(name); return { version: 2, beforeEventSha256: a.beforeEventSha256, afterEventSha256: a.afterEventSha256, completion: a.completion, workCompletion: null }; };

const selected={kind:'accept',node:20,previous:'110-e1-accept-19'};

function proposal(q){
  const source=q.source,inputs=q.inputs,frozen=t.transitionBound(inputs.baseline),prior=done(selected.previous),snapshot=structuredClone(prior.recorded.result.observation.transition.snapshot);
  assert.equal(snapshot.fixed.runId,q.runId);assert.equal(snapshot.fixed.memoryBindingSha256,q.memoryRequest.expected.bindingSha256);
  assert.deepEqual(snapshot.baseline,inputs.baseline);assert.equal(snapshot.store.headSha256,inputs.acceptedStore.expectedHeadSha256);
  assert.equal(snapshot.source.root,source.root);assert.equal(snapshot.source.commit,source.commit);assert.equal(snapshot.source.tree,source.expectedTree);assert.equal(gitIdentity(source.root).dirty,false);assert.equal(snapshot.worker,null);
  assert.equal(snapshot.registry.root,frozen.registry.root);assert.equal(snapshot.registry.headSha256,frozen.registry.headSha256);assert.deepEqual(snapshot.fixed.graph,inputs.graph);assert.deepEqual(snapshot.fixed.plan,inputs.plan);
  assert.deepEqual(frozen.overlayFiles,['Specs/CheckerOverlayV1.lean']);assert.equal(source.commit,read(path.join(base,'actors/e1-h/work.json')).candidate.commit);
  for(const row of read(path.join(base,'fixture-input-inventory.json')))assert.equal(sha(fs.readFileSync(path.join(c.integration,row.path))),row.sha256,row.path);
  return snapshot;
}

  const executeCalledAtMs=Date.now(),executed=auto.executeTransition({projectRoot:c.root,request:item.q,beforeOut:b.out,producerOut:path.join(dir(),'producer'),evidenceDir:path.join(dir(),'command')});
